integrity: The complete nine-point computations are reproducible from embedded standard-library Python. The previously published integral homology of the line-free complex and its Alexander-dual homology implications are excluded from the novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Theorem only for the nine-point affine plane, with complete finite integer cancellation; no larger-order or equivariant classification, no independent external audit, and unresolved publication-priority risk for inaccessible primary material.
title: Dual sphere-wedge homotopy types in the nine-point affine plane
